notes.title: A small UI update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
I often get comments that the "technical" interface significantly spoils the impression of the game.
I agree, so here’s a small change.
This is still not the final version, but rather an intermediate one, since the white color has already started to annoy me a bit ;)
